description: This file implements backup-related services for the Notesnook mobile application, including directory management, backup creation, progress handling, and scheduling logic.

methods.name: getDirectoryAndroid
methods.description: Obtains or creates the Android backup directory, handling user prompts if necessary.

methods.name: checkBackupDirExists
methods.description: Checks if the backup directory exists, optionally resetting or prompting the user.

methods.name: presentBackupCompleteSheet
methods.description: Displays a sheet indicating backup completion with options to share or dismiss.

methods.name: updateNextBackupTime
methods.description: Updates the last backup time and schedules the next backup.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Performs the backup process, including zipping data, saving attachments, and handling platform-specific storage.

methods.name: cleanupAfterBackup
methods.description: Removes temporary files created during backup.

methods.name: checkBackupRequired
methods.description: Determines if a backup is needed based on the last backup time and schedule.

methods.name: checkAndRun
methods.description: Checks if a backup is required and initiates it if necessary.
